chunks: if the actions of a governor follow the passions he will be greatly hampered in justice. All the people should be equal in right before you, because injustice cannot be a substitute for justice. Avoid that thing the like of which you would not like for yourself. Exert yourself in what Allāh has made obligatory on you, hoping for His reward and fearing His chastisement.
ai.seo_question: What are the key qualities of justice and self-discipline for a governor according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali advises the governor to overcome the paralyzing effect of personal whims (hawa) by ensuring impartiality, a core tenet of Shia political ethics where justice is viewed as the foundation of governance. The instruction to 'humiliate oneself' (ibtil al-nafs) reflects the spiritual discipline required of leaders to remain accessible and accountable, balancing hope (rajā’) and fear (khawf) as they execute divine obligations.
